focus_guard.hookLine: 2:30 AM: Phir se Reels? Not again!
focus_guard.title: Reel Addiction vs. Exam Goals? #FocusGuard
focus_guard.storySummary: Arjun loses hours to doomscrolling reels every night. Priya introduces him to Aspirant Arcade's Focus Guard, which intercepts distracting apps with MCQs, helping him reclaim his study time.

short_notes.title: The Revision Rescue Mission!
short_notes.storySummary: Arjun is overwhelmed by massive books and PDFs for exam revision. Priya introduces him to Aspirant Arcade's 'Short Notes for Every Exam' feature, showcasing how it simplifies revision with crisp, organized, and searchable notes.

ai_notes_quiz.title: Smart Notes, Smart Scores!
ai_notes_quiz.storySummary: Arjun struggles with passive revision and not knowing his weak points. Priya introduces Aspirant Arcade's AI Notes + Quiz feature, which generates custom notes and then quizzes him, providing a detailed marks breakdown, solving his problem.

arcade_games.hookLine: MCQs se aankhein jal gayi, dimaag fry ho gaya!
arcade_games.title: Boring Prep Se Burnout? Game On!
arcade_games.storySummary: Arjun struggles with eye strain and burnout from endless MCQ sheets. Priya introduces Aspirant Arcade's 14+ arcade games, transforming his boring study into an addictive, stress-free learning experience with action games and XP rewards.
